contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]NVS AVG. Reverse description: Possibly two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 17.0mm, Weight: 1.97gms, die axis: possibly 12
